> **Automatic Community publication.** A PR that changes only `entries/<name>.json` and `skills/<name>/`
> of an existing, non-Official Community skill, opened by the owner recorded on main, is merged automatically
> once the deterministic checks pass. Independent maintainer review is not required on that path, and merging
> does not grant Official endorsement. The merge keeps your commits. New skills, ownership changes, Official
> releases and other files need maintainer review.
